cli.description: A CLI tool that takes you from source code to a fully running local environment powered by k3d
cli.initDescription: Create kustron-env.yaml in the current folder
cli.upDescription: Bring up the environment and deploy all apps
cli.reloadDescription: Down + up (pick up any yaml changes)
cli.addDescription: Add a new app entry to kustron-env.yaml
cli.removeDescription: Remove an app entry from kustron-env.yaml
cli.registryImportDescription: Import local images into the kustron cluster (k3d image import)
cli.sourceOption: Local path or git SSH/HTTPS URL
cli.healthcheckOption: Healthcheck: /path (HTTP GET), tcp (port check), none (default: no probes)
cli.haOption: HA mode: min 2, max 5 replicas, CPU 90%, mem 80%
cli.doctorDescription: Check that kustron's runtime dependencies are installed and the container runtime daemon is reachable
cli.appDescription: Stop, start, inspect, and proxy a single app by name
cli.appStopDescription: Stop a single app without touching the rest of the environment
cli.appStartDescription: Start a single app that was previously stopped
cli.appLogsDescription: Stream logs for a single app (-f follow, -t N last lines)
cli.appExecDescription: Run a command inside a single running app container (default: sh)
cli.appForwardDescription: Forward a local port to a single app
cli.initPortOption: app port (default: 3000 for source, 80 for image)

init.existsForceHint: kustron-env.yaml already exists. Pass --force (-f) to overwrite it.
init.badPort: Invalid port: {{port}} (expected an integer between 1 and 65535)
init.nextHint: Next: edit kustron-env.yaml if needed, then run 'kustron env up'

up.noEnvFile: No kustron-env.yaml found. Run `kustron env init` to create one.
up.clusterExists: Cluster '{{name}}' already exists and is running. Skipping creation.
up.startingCluster: Cluster '{{name}}' exists but is stopped. Starting it...
up.missingDepsHint: Missing dependencies. Run `kustron env init` first to install them.

down.confirm: Are you sure you want to tear down cluster '{{name}}'?
down.notFound: Cluster '{{name}}' not found. Nothing to do.

destroy.confirm: Delete cluster '{{name}}' and all data in it?
destroy.success: Cluster '{{name}}' destroyed. Your kubeconfig is untouched.
destroy.notFound: Cluster '{{name}}' not found. Nothing to do.

status.noEnvFile: No kustron-env.yaml found. Run `kustron env init` to create one.
status.clusterNotCreated: Cluster '{{name}}' does not exist. Run `kustron env up` to create it.
status.clusterNotRunning: Cluster '{{name}}' exists but is not running. Run `kustron env up` to start it.

add.exactlyOneSource: Exactly one of --source, --image, or --helm-chart is required.
add.portRequired: --port is required for source and image apps.
add.reloadHint: Run `kustron env reload` to apply changes.

remove.reloadHint: Run `kustron env reload` to apply changes.

checks.missingRequiredError: Missing required dependencies. Please install them and try again.
checks.optionalMissing: Optional dependencies missing: {{deps}}. Some features may be unavailable.

doctor.daemonNotRunning: Container runtime daemon is NOT reachable.
doctor.daemonHint: Start your runtime (e.g. `podman machine start`, or open Docker Desktop / OrbStack), then re-run `kustron doctor`.
doctor.summaryFail: kustron is not ready: required dependencies are missing or the container runtime daemon is down.
doctor.summaryHint: Install the missing dependencies above (or run the install script, which installs them for you: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/itsmunim/kustron/master/install.sh), then re-run `kustron doctor`.
doctor.summaryOk: kustron environment is ready: all required dependencies are installed and the container runtime is reachable.

deploy.rolloutTimeout: Rollout timed out after {{timeout}}s — pods are running, continuing.
deploy.imagePullFailed: Image could not be pulled (ImagePullBackOff). Check the image name and that it exists in the registry.
deploy.crashLoop: Container keeps crashing (CrashLoopBackOff). See pod details below.
deploy.helmExposureWarning: Cannot expose helm app '{{name}}' without a selector. Add `helm.selector` to kustron-env.yaml and run `kustron env reload`.
deploy.gitAccessDenied: Cannot access '{{url}}'. Please set up SSH access to your Git provider and try again.

errors.containerRuntimeNotRunning: Container runtime (Podman/Docker) does not appear to be running. Start it and try again.
errors.podmanSocketNotFound: Podman socket not found. Run `podman machine init` followed by `podman machine start`, then try again.
errors.railpackMissing: Railpack is required to build this app but is not installed. Install it from https://railpack.io or add a Dockerfile to your project.
